authorization: Owner requests ETH feature and training improvements beyond thresholds; offline single-variable comparisons only.
single_variable: Each new arm differs directly from the original expanding ETH netR model in one feature group or one training setting. No combinations or post-test winner refitting.

training_variants.decay_26w: Original equal-NY-week weights times 2**(-age_weeks/26), age measured from label expiry to train cutoff; renormalize mean weight to1.
training_variants.window_52w: Use only complete NY weeks starting no earlier than52calendar weeks before the test quarter; original equal-week weights.
training_variants.leaves_3: Change num_leaves from7to3 only; original training history, weights and other settings.

baseline_weights: Already equal total weight per symbol/NY week; do not misrepresent existing protection as a new change.
decision_clock: All features end at submission_i, the closed5m bar before the native touch; BTC bars have exactly matching close timestamps. No touch or later candle enters features.
execution: Reuse unchanged Nautilus fills. Existing baseline/unscored/single-feature selections reused; VectorBT handles only new policy admission and accounting on original fills. One position, same submission/exit ordering, one dollar original risk per trade.
gate: score>0 expected native netR, fixed for every arm; no threshold/calibration or barrier changes.
split: Quarterly expanding tests2025Q1..2026Q4, training label expiry<=test-quarter start; test week starts inside quarter. Whole NY weeks purged; incomplete current week never trains/evaluates.
controls: original matched random entries with same target/stop/expiry
statistics: Weekly bootstrap2000/signflip10000; Holm across all18 arm-target matched comparisons and separately18 versus-original improvements. Require positive absolute-net CI, both adjusted p<0.01 and positive improvement CI for historical evidence. Within-fold AUC/topdecile/permutation; report years,sides,quarters,profit concentration and fixed-gate alternate native path.
historical_use: Exploratory known history; no untouched validation or automatic selection/promotion. Near primary, far/opposite secondary.
